# Kryvex Media

> Kryvex Media is a full-service digital marketing agency: SEO, PPC/Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, web design & development, content marketing, local SEO, email marketing, and graphic design — run by one in-house team, not outsourced freelancers. Every engagement starts with a free audit, runs month-to-month with no lock-in contracts, and reports on real leads and revenue rather than vanity metrics. Kryvex Media serves small and mid-sized businesses across India, the USA, the UK, Singapore, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, and Indonesia.

## Services

- [SEO](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/seo/): Technical, on-page, local and content SEO that gets businesses found on Google.
- [PPC / Google Ads](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/ppc/): Paid search campaigns with every dollar tracked to a lead or sale.
- [Meta Ads](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram full-funnel ad campaigns.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/social-media/): Content, reels and community management that builds an audience that buys.
- [Web Design & Development](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/web-design/): Fast, conversion-focused websites, including a 72-hour delivery option.
- [Local SEO](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, map-pack and near-me search optimization.
- [Content Marketing](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/content-marketing/): SEO blogs, lead magnets and distribution built around buyer search intent.
- [Email Marketing](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/email-marketing/): Automated flows, broadcasts and segmentation.
- [Graphic Design](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/graphics-design/): On-brand social, ad, web and print creative.
- [All services](https://kryvexmedia.com/services/): Full list of services offered.
